title: Портной, свидание и Пригожин  (The Tailor, the Date, and Prigozhin)

segments.t: Instead of dieting, Chef Barinov secretly visits a tailor to have his tight suit let out. Meanwhile, Ainura tells Lyova that Gulya agreed to a date in a week, and Max—chasing the locker-room thief into traffic—gets bumped by producer Iosif Prigozhin's car.
По-моему, неплохо. Отлично сидит!
Спасибо, Соломон Иванович. Теперь всё можно!
Хорошая новость. Гуля согласна.
Но есть и плохая.
Тебе придётся ждать целую неделю.
Только она просила никому не говорить.
Айнура очень строгая, может запретить.
Вы на Иосифа Пригожина похожи.
К сожалению, я он и есть.
Меня сбил Иосиф Пригожин!
Если можно, пусть это останется между нами.
Чёрт, Вика!
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
По-моему, неплохо. Отлично сидит!
'In my opinion, not bad. It fits great!' With the suit and news at stake, Barinov reacts without holding back. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Спасибо, Соломон Иванович. Теперь всё можно!
'Thank you, Solomon Ivanovich. Now everything is allowed!' Because now everything is allowed, Barinov does not bother softening the blow for Ainura.
Хорошая новость. Гуля согласна.
'Good news. Gulya agrees.' Over the shift and the news, Ainura answers Barinov without a second thought.
Но есть и плохая.
'But there is also bad news.' Even though there is also bad news, Ainura keeps a steady face in front of Barinov.
Тебе придётся ждать целую неделю.
'You will have to wait a whole week.' Admitting that Barinov will have to wait a whole week shows Ainura being honest for a change.
Только она просила никому не говорить.
'Only she asked not to tell anyone.' Saying that only she asked not to tell anyone is how Ainura sets the tone with Barinov.
Айнура очень строгая, может запретить.
'Ainura is very strict, she might forbid it.' Once Ainura is very strict she might forbid it, Ainura can finally tell Barinov what she means.
Вы на Иосифа Пригожина похожи.
'You look like Iosif Prigozhin.' Adding that Ainura looks like Iosif Prigozhin fills in the missing piece for Ainura.
К сожалению, я он и есть.
'Unfortunately, I am him.' Barinov explains that he is him, keeping his voice calm and direct.
Меня сбил Иосиф Пригожин!
'Iosif Prigozhin hit me!' Insisting that Iosif Prigozhin hit him shows Max is not backing down. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Если можно, пусть это останется между нами.
'If possible, let this stay between us.' Mentioning that if possible let this stay between them moves the talk in a new direction.
Чёрт, Вика!

'Damn, Vika!' Around the answer and news, Max makes his point loud and clear. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.

Но есть и плохая.

Вы на Иосифа Пригожина похожи.
К сожалению, я он и есть.
Меня сбил Иосиф Пригожин!
Если можно, пусть это останется между нами.
Чёрт, Вика!
That brings this multi-part scene to a close. Notice how Max reacts in disbelief when he realizes celebrity producer Iosif Prigozhin's car hit him while Vika was waiting. See you next time!
Всего хорошего!
